name: Johannesburg
blurb: Johannesburg remains one of the most discussed destinations in the country, with steady volume across the period and no unusual movement.

positive: Good value compared with last year
Easy to get around without a car
Food repeatedly singled out as a highlight
negative: Prices noticeably up on last season
Some report crowding at peak times

quotes.text: Spent a week here working remotely, wifi was fine everywhere.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
Second time here and it still feels underrated.
